locale.conf.excerpt:
Description ¶ The /etc/locale.conf file configures
    system-wide locale settings. It is read at early boot by systemd (1) . The format of locale.conf is a newline-separated list of environment-like

    configuration from shell scripts, however, beyond mere variable assignments, no shell features are
    supported, allowing applications to read the file without implementing a shell compatible execution
